name: Embrapa OpenApiTests Local Contract Testing
free_limit: MIT-licensed .NET CLI that generates HTTP contract tests from OpenAPI specifications, executes tests against user-provided REST APIs and produces HTML reports; no software subscription, usage quota or expiry stated.
watch_out: Requires a local .NET runtime and reachable API/test environment; does not include free hosted test infrastructure, API hosting or CI minutes. Tests can send real HTTP requests and modify data; use safe test environments. Upstream README contains formatting errors, so validate scenarios before production CI use.
